FX-ENERGY-001.says: The settings as added: a beam from a quarter across to three quarters across, half way down, core 8 across, softness 30, a blue glow spread 40 at intensity 100, added to the drawing. On a drawing this small the glow reaches every pixel.

FX-ENERGY-002.says: Core 3, spread 6: a thin white line with its blue glow, the rest of the drawing lit faintly.

FX-ENERGY-003.says: Composite transparent: the light alone, the night sky gone.

FX-ENERGY-004.says: Composite black: the light over black, every pixel whole.

FX-ENERGY-005.says: Glow spread 0: the core alone, no glow anywhere.

FX-ENERGY-006.says: Core size 0: the glow alone, blue all through, no white.

FX-ENERGY-007.says: Core softness 0 and 100: hard, then soft from the middle out.

FX-ENERGY-009.says: Glow intensity 400, an orange glow: past 1 where the glow is strong.

FX-ENERGY-010.says: End offset 50: the beam from its start to half way, ending at the middle.

FX-ENERGY-011.says: Start offset 75, End offset 25: taken smaller first, the middle half.

FX-ENERGY-012.says: Start offset 40, End offset 40: nothing drawn, the drawing as it was.

FX-ENERGY-013.says: End offset keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the beam draws on, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-ENERGY-014.says: Start size 100, End size 0: the beam tapers to a point at its end.

FX-ENERGY-015.says: Start size 0 and End size 0: no width anywhere, nothing drawn.

FX-ENERGY-016.says: Core start and end keyed: the beam from the top-left corner to the bottom-right at frame 0, swinging to the bottom-left to the top-right at frame 4, frames 0 and 4.

FX-ENERGY-017.says: Path From Masks, the box from (2, 2) to (13, 7): the beam all round it.

FX-ENERGY-018.says: The box, End offset 50: half way round it, from its top-left corner.

FX-ENERGY-019.says: The box, End offset 50, Evolution 90: the same half, begun a quarter of the way round, at the top-right corner.

FX-ENERGY-020.says: The box, End offset 50, Evolution 450: a turn and a quarter, FX-ENERGY-019's frame.

FX-ENERGY-021.says: The box, End offset 25, Evolution keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4: a quarter of the box travelling round it, frames 0, 1, 2 and 4.

FX-ENERGY-022.says: Two masks, the box and a small box inside it: both, the glow of each the nearer's.

FX-ENERGY-023.says: The box, distortion 1.5 at scale 4, speed 0: the beam wobbles but stays joined round the box, and is the same at frame 0 and 3.

FX-ENERGY-024.says: Distortion 1.5 at scale 4, speed 50: the wobble moves, frames 0, 1 and 2.

FX-ENERGY-025.says: FX-ENERGY-023 with Random Seed 7: a different wobble.

FX-ENERGY-026.says: The straight beam with distortion 1 at scale 3: an open path wobbles too.

FX-ENERGY-027.says: Flicker 80 at speed 30: the whole light dims and brightens frame by frame, frames 0 to 4.

FX-ENERGY-028.says: Flicker 80 at speed 0: held, the same each frame, frames 0 and 4.

FX-ENERGY-029.says: Path From Shapes, the box as a shape layer's shape: FX-ENERGY-017's beam on the shape layer (transparent), added.

FX-ENERGY-030.says: An open shape, a roof of two legs: drawn open, nothing along the bottom.

FX-ENERGY-031.says: The open roof, Evolution 180: an open path has no evolution, FX-ENERGY-030's frame.

FX-ENERGY-032.says: The box mask with Path From Points: the mask is not used, the straight beam, FX-ENERGY-002's frame.

FX-ENERGY-033.says: FX-ENERGY-002 moved three pixels right: the beam moves with the drawing.

FX-ENERGY-034.says: Path From Text Outlines, "Yes" (D-373's text layer, 48 by 30): every outline glows, core 1.5, spread 3, the light alone (Transparent).

FX-ENERGY-035.says: "Yes", End offset keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: each outline draws on round itself, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-ENERGY-036.says: Path From Masks, no masks. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGY-037.says: Path From Masks, the one mask switched off. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGY-038.says: Path From Shapes on the night drawing, which is not a shape layer. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGY-039.says: Path From Text Outlines on a shape layer with no shapes. Nothing to draw along: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGY-040.says: Core size 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
